sentences.en: Sometimes it's fun to creep yourself out thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 有时候想想这件事会让自己毛骨悚然还挺有趣的。

sentences.en: You scared me! Don't creep up on people like that.
sentences.zh: 你吓到我了！别这样悄悄靠近人，太吓人了。

sentences.en: Stop staring at me like this. You're creeping me out.
sentences.zh: 别这么盯着我看。你让我感到很不舒服。

senses.zh: 爬行；毛骨悚然的感觉；谄媚者
